description:
Free discovery: PAYER-side 0-100 intel score for a wallet from the x402
    payments it SENT (paid calls, distinct counterparties, volume, recency).
    Not a seller check: to vet a seller/payTo before paying, use
    get_readiness_card_tool (gate) or get_provider_reputation / get_merchant_card
    (seller reputation). A pure seller scores 0 here by construction and the
    response says so in seller_side_hint. A Base 0x wallet is scored from the
    relayer-attributed x402_base_daily rollup (90d) with the same shape; no Base
    wash graph exists yet, so its wash_flag is "unknown" unless single-counterparty.

    Uses a simple transparent heuristic (volume log + breadth + spend log + recency
    decay) — the exact formula is returned inline as `score_model`. Returns
    intel_score, the wash-discounted effective_score + wash_flag/wash_factor
    (cheap Sybil signal), counts, component breakdown, and a data_available flag.
    Malformed pubkeys are rejected cleanly; the failure path returns the same
    shape as success.

    Sourced from the cross-facilitator corpus via the public Rust HTTP endpoint
    GET /v1/agents/{wallet}/x402 (backed by the x402_solana_payer_agg matview).
    First paid hop is the score-only teaser GET /v1/intel/quick/{wallet} (0.001 USDC).
    Optional V7 signed receipt (intel_renorm_v1_1: score_raw, confidence,
    breadth_factor, wash_factor) is GET /v1/intel/trust/{wallet} (0.05 USDC).

wallet.description: Wallet to score: a Solana base58 pubkey or a Base 0x address, using x402 payment-history intelligence.
wallet.title: Wallet

name: score_wallet_for_intel

chain.description: "base" when scored from the Base corpus; null on the Solana path.
chain.title: Chain

data_available.description: False when the corpus could not be observed (vs genuinely inactive).
data_available.title: Data Available

distinct_counterparties.description: Distinct counterparties (merchants paid + payers received from).
distinct_counterparties.title: Distinct Counterparties

error.description: Present only on the degraded path.
error.title: Error

first_seen.description: ISO timestamp of first observed activity.
first_seen.title: First Seen

is_single_counterparty.description: True if all payments went to one counterparty (Sybil signal).
is_single_counterparty.title: Is Single Counterparty

last_seen.description: ISO timestamp of last observed activity.
last_seen.title: Last Seen

network.description: CAIP-2 network of the corpus used, e.g. "eip155:8453"; null on the Solana path.
network.title: Network

paid_calls.description: Observed x402 paid calls SENT (payer side).
paid_calls.title: Paid Calls

payments_received.description: Observed x402 paid calls RECEIVED (merchant side).
payments_received.title: Payments Received

score_components.description: Per-component breakdown: volume, breadth, spend, recency_factor.
score_components.title: Score Components

score_model.description: Self-describing scoring contract (scale, formula, component maxes, recency tiers).
score_model.title: Score Model

seller_side_hint.description: Set when this wallet reads as a SELLER (role merchant, or payments received with no paid calls sent). intel_score here is the PAYER-side score and is 0 for a pure seller by construction; it is not a verdict about the seller. Points at get_provider_reputation / get_merchant_card (seller side) and get_readiness_card_tool (the pre-spend gate).
seller_side_hint.title: Seller Side Hint

wallet.description: The scored wallet: Solana base58 pubkey or Base 0x address (lowercased).
wallet.title: Wallet

wash_coverage.description: Which wash signals exist for this chain. Base: single-counterparty only, so wash_flag is "unknown" (never "clean") for multi-counterparty wallets.
wash_coverage.title: Wash Coverage

wash_factor.description: Multiplier applied to intel_score for effective_score.
wash_factor.title: Wash Factor

window_days.description: Observation window in days when the corpus is windowed (Base: 90); null on the Solana path.
window_days.title: Window Days
